exposure: Umbilical cord length between the first and tenth percentile
Umbilical cord length less than the first percentile
cohort: Women who attempted vaginal birth at the institution where the study was conducted
finding: An umbilical cord length of 45 cm or less was associated with an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including unplanned cesarean delivery and small-for-gestational-age births.
mod_finding: The study found that a short umbilical cord (≤ 45 cm) was associated with an increased risk of unplanned cesarean delivery.
